messages:
sara: Need a compact DP launch-gates checklist for the roadmap review tomorrow. Keep it ops-friendly and measurable.

jake: Quick idea: 3 gates - Recruit, Integrate, Release. Each gate has 2 signals.

sara: Sounds good. Propose signals: Recruit = NDA+SOW signed, commitment to 2x 30-min syncs/month. Integrate = end-to-end demo + smoke tests pass. Release = 2-week stability window + 1 structured eval with score >=7.

mina: Add an "ops safety" row: monitoring hook in place, incident contact listed, and rollback plan defined.

lex: Legal: include a one-line data handling note on the checklist for private DPs (archive window & KMS). I'll drop the wording.

ops-bot: Template available: /ops/templates/dp-launch-gates.md. Can auto-create monitoring hooks once owners are tagged.

sara: Also propose a short eviction FAQ: 7-day notice, 30-day archive, rehab = 2 consecutive good weeks. Keep language friendly.

jake: I'll sketch the slide and share a tiny CSV scorecard for recruitment scoring (impact, effort, availability).

mina: I'll draft the structured eval (3 quick questions + 1 open comment) and a pass/fail threshold.

sara: Owners: sara (slide), jake (scorecard), mina (eval), lex (legal blurb). Ops to wire templates. Meet IRL in 30 to finalize.
